protocol: v19 Task C: controlled retraining of the ellipse multiplier (prompt docs/prompts/RUN_v19_ELLIPSE.md)
frozen: 2026-10-14, written and committed before any training of either run
status_of_results: post_hoc relative to protocols v1/v2; no protocol row is changed; the v2 ellipse gate stays failed
hypothesis: the squared head lambda_psi = M_psi^2 has zero gradient at M_psi = 0; once M_psi collapses the multiplier cannot recover, the network approximates the unconstrained problem, the state undershoots the obstacle on a region larger than the contact set, and the ring mismatch raises U_S

problem_constants.reliability_formula: weighted B = 18 U_r + 36 U_p + 12 U_c (diffusion only); uniform C_rel = 36
problem_constants.Lambda_justification: c_F <= diam(Omega) = sqrt(2) on the unit square, so Lambda = 2 >= c_F^2

intervention.difference_from_control: after the seeded default initialisation the output bias of M_psi is set to 1.0 (lambda_psi ~ 1 at the start); lambda_psi = M_psi^2 kept; no exact-solution information

identical_fields: every field of reference_run.config except seed and sobol_seeds (derived from the seed), experiment, hardware, git_commit, git_dirty: architecture 6x64 tanh, square head, mask, n_int 20000, n_init 2000, loss weights (1,1,1,10,10), Adam lr 1e-3 5000 steps, L-BFGS lr 1 max_iter 1 strong Wolfe <= 300 steps with the same abort rules, kappa0 1/100, threads 3; same training budget
training_script: experiments/v19/multiplier_train.py = experiments/v14/ellipse_train.py + arm + read-only psi_monitor.csv (max lambda_psi and fraction lambda_psi > 1e-6 on the collocation points, ||grad_psi L_train||, every step); control == ellipse_train bit for bit (tests/test_v19_multiplier_train.py)

evaluation.stage0: python3 -m certified_obstacle_nn.experiments.v14.ellipse_validated --seeds 3 --budgets 100000 --arb-seeds --train-run <training run> --index results/v19_C_index/<arm>.jsonl (stored run with the TM1-weighted trace partitions, 16384 cells each, as for seeds 0-2)
evaluation.protocol_v1: docs/v17_frozen_protocol.json unchanged: bash certified_obstacle_nn/scripts/v17b_protocol_v1.sh steps123 <stage0 run> 16, then step4 <partition> <stage0 run> 16 (uniform 128^3, TM1 in chunks, ONE Doerfler flux step theta 1/2 capped at 3.5e6 cells, frozen, from-scratch TM1 evaluation); validated numbers from the step-4 run
evaluation.output_routing: CERT_EXPERIMENT_PREFIX=v19_C_<arm>_ so every run directory is results/v19_C_<arm>_*/<ts>/
evaluation.G_AR: G_AR/N from the step-4 run's validated U_R, U_S, U_I, U_C (scripts/make_v19_grad_ar.g_ar, 192-bit arb, up; N_lower down)
evaluation.diagnostics: experiments/v19/substitution.py on the step-4 run (A0-A5 exact integrals on the frozen v1 partition of that network, q = 2; slices t = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 on a 1024 x 1024 midpoint grid)

predictions.P1: intervention has max lambda_psi >= 1e-3 max lambda on all three slices; control does not
predictions.P2: the area ratio {v<g} / contact set is below 1.5 on all slices for intervention, and not for control
predictions.P3: the exact-integral U_S of intervention is below that of control
predictions.P4: the validated v1 G_AR/N of intervention is below that of control

prediction_evaluation.P1: per slice t, max over the 1024^2 slice grid of lambda_psi vs of the exact lambda (slices.csv 'max lambda_psi', 'max lambda (exact)'); confirmed iff intervention passes on all three slices AND control fails on at least one
prediction_evaluation.P2: slices.csv 'area {v<g} / area contact'; confirmed iff intervention < 1.5 on all three AND control >= 1.5 on at least one
prediction_evaluation.P3: substitution.csv A0 'U_S (I)' on each network's own frozen v1 partition; confirmed iff intervention < control

rules: predictions are not changed after training starts; a refuted prediction is reported with the same weight; if a run fails (non-finite loss, crash) it is reported as such and not re-run with other settings
